title: VaultTec — Phase 4c Exit Test Report
method: Exit test on the SAME three out-of-sample windows as Phase 4b (OOS-1, OOS-2, OOS-3) plus the Phase 4 window re-run and labelled in-sample: delayed real market history from yfinance (free), 70 days of warm-up history before each window so the SMA-50 filter is defined on day one, 12 symbols, 5-day walk-forward steps, signals from history up to the trade day only — no look-ahead. Every trade goes through the real PaperTradingEngine and Risk Engine, balanced profile, $10,000 virtual cash, long-only. Every variant keeps a stop-loss; the stop is never removed.
data_source: yfinance (delayed real market data, free — Yahoo Finance)
downtrend_filter_rule: Skip the buy when BOTH hold on the trade day (history up to that day only): (a) the close is below its 50-day simple moving average, and (b) that 50-day average is falling — today's SMA-50 is below the SMA-50 of 10 bars ago. If the SMA-50 is not yet defined, the filter does NOT block.

variants.description: Phase 4b Variant A control, re-run as a sanity check.

variants.description: Wider stop so normal daily wobbles do not stop the trade out; target widens to keep 1.5:1.

variants.label: Wider stop — 6% stop / 9% target / 10 days
variants.description: Even wider stop; target widens to keep 1.5:1.

variants.label: Downtrend filter — 3% stop / 4.5% target / 10 days + filter
variants.description: Same exits as baseline, but oversold buys are skipped while the downtrend filter says the market is falling.

variants.label: Time-based exit — 3% stop / 4.5% target / 5 days
variants.description: Half the holding time: if the bounce has not happened in 5 days, exit instead of waiting 10.

variants.label: Signal exit — 3% stop, no fixed target, exit on reversal / 10 days
variants.description: Stop still protects every trade; otherwise hold until the entry signal reverses (RSI > 70 / close >= upper band) or 10 days pass. No fixed target — the Risk Engine is passed no target.

variants.label: Combined — Wider stop — 5% stop / 7.5% target / 10 days + downtrend filter
variants.description: Wider stop so normal daily wobbles do not stop the trade out; target widens to keep 1.5:1. PLUS the downtrend filter: oversold buys are skipped while the market is in a downtrend. Post-hoc: the base variant was chosen after seeing the base results on these same windows, so this result needs a fresh window to confirm.

rsi.reason: Highest pooled out-of-sample total paper P&L among ['wide-5', 'wide-6', 'time-5d', 'signal-exit'] for RSI mean-reversion (buy RSI < 30, sell RSI > 70) ($1,517.23). Post-hoc selection on these same windows — needs a fresh window to confirm.

bollinger.reason: Highest pooled out-of-sample total paper P&L among ['wide-5', 'wide-6', 'time-5d', 'signal-exit'] for Bollinger mean-reversion (buy lower band, sell upper band) ($888.92). Post-hoc selection on these same windows — needs a fresh window to confirm.

combined_selection_rule: Per strategy, the base variant with the highest pooled out-of-sample total paper P&L among wide-5, wide-6, time-5d and signal-exit, run with the downtrend filter added. Post-hoc — chosen after seeing the base results on these same windows.
verdict_rules: A variant 'survives OOS-2' when its OOS-2 paper P&L is >= $0. A variant is 'worth keeping' when its pooled out-of-sample P&L is > $0 AND it survives OOS-2. At 1.5:1 risk/reward the break-even win rate is exactly 40%.

note: Nothing here proves future profits: past performance does not guarantee future results. Seven variants were tested on the same three windows, so the best-looking one is partly the best by chance (multiple comparisons) — a variant that only looks good here needs a fresh window before it is trusted. The combined variant was selected after seeing the base results on these same windows, so it is not independent evidence either. Live paper trades over real days plus a compliance/legal review are still required before any real money is considered.
